description: React component for exporting 'bandes' (probably segments or annotations) as an SRT subtitle file within a web application. It provides UI for exporting the current state of bandes as a downloadable .srt file, including sorting and formatting the data.

methods.name: ExportModal()
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal dialog for exporting bandes as an SRT file. Includes methods for converting data to SRT format and triggering download.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the export modal by toggling the visibility state.

methods.name: toSrt
methods.description: Converts the bandes data into a properly formatted SRT subtitle string, sorted by start time.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Creates a Blob from the SRT string and triggers a download of the file named 'bandes_export.srt'.
